new_results.statement: For each transverse bank G define tau_G as the l2 distance of the longitudinal coefficient row from span(v_G,w_G). The bank Gram determinant is det(S_G) tau_G^2. If tau_J tau_K>0, the physical J|K cross-block singular-volume is Gamma=|det M|sqrt(det S_J det S_K)tau_Jtau_K>=tau_Jtau_K/640, hence ||p_Q||inf<51.707(tau_Jtau_K)^(-1/3).

new_results.statement: If tau_J=0 then U_J=aV_J+dW_J exactly. Conditioning the other bank leaves an independent scalar and a dependent 2D pair; the conditional 3x3 determinant is -c b^2 gamma and the dependence-safe null-scalar theorem gives ||p_Q||inf<100.711. Symmetric for K.
With h=Z_J^Tu_J=-Z_K^Tu_K and rho=1-c, rho=tau_J^2+tau_K^2+h^T(S_J^-1+S_K^-1)h, so 4||h||^2<=rho-tau_J^2-tau_K^2.
